card.line: Shunem was a city in the land of Issachar. The Philistines camped there before Saul's last battle, and Elisha often stopped there to eat.

moments.title: A city for Issachar
moments.text: When the land was divided, Shunem was named among the cities in the territory given to the tribe of Issachar.

moments.title: The Philistines camp at Shunem
moments.text: The Philistines gathered and camped at Shunem, while Saul gathered all Israel at Gilboa. When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid and trembled violently.

moments.title: A woman feeds Elisha
moments.text: A prominent woman of Shunem persuaded Elisha to have a meal. Whenever he passed by, he stopped there to eat.

moments.title: A room for the man of God
moments.text: The woman saw that Elisha was a holy man of God. She and her husband made a small upstairs room for him with a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp.
